name: ema_crossover_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, systematic momentum algorithms and TWAP/VWAP institutional executors track short-vs-medium EMA alignment at the 1-3 minute scale. When EMA(12) crosses above EMA(36) — a 1-minute trend flipping above a 3-minute reference — it marks the inflection where net buy-side order flow has conclusively overwhelmed the prior sell pressure: the institutional TWAP that initiated the push still has unexecuted volume, while fresh momentum algos pile in within seconds of the cross detecting the regime shift. On NIFTY specifically, this fast-EMA cross fires 4-8 times per session and each cross tends to sustain 30-90 seconds of continuation before the slower EMA catches up and the edge dissipates. Death crosses (EMA12 below EMA36) signal the symmetric sell-side flow acceleration.
core_signal_oneliner: Fresh EMA(12)/EMA(36) golden or death cross with price confirming above/below the fast EMA
